name: Claude Data (dashboard artifact type)
what: Dashboards, metrics pages, KPI trackers, recurring reports, scroll stories and one to two minute played data shorts, drawn with d3. Every number is marked with its source. A dataset is a live connector query, an uploaded file or rows saved on the page.
install: No install line. Artifacts and the Data template must be on for the claude.ai account; on Team and Enterprise an organization Owner enables them in organization settings. In Claude Code, sign in with /login and a claude.ai account.
firstCall: Artifact quickstart with intent 'other' when the host offers it, else an Artifact types list, to get the type link; then read the type's SKILL.md that the create call returns
evidenceNote: Artifact read calls on the type's SKILL.md, design-defaults, visual-short, design-system, looks and exporting files succeeded. Public Help Center pages on artifacts were read. NOT exercised: creating a dashboard, any ArtifactData write, a live connector dataset, PDF or CSV export, the Vercel snapshot import. The type itself has no per-call credits, but a live dataset re-runs its connector query for every reader, and a metered connector can then spend; that billing is unverified. With no artifacts in the session the fallback is a static chart page in code, which has no catalog id.
